pyramiding_rule: Strict prohibition against adding to positions when floating profit is negative or within 30 seconds of a prior stop-out sequence.
new_mandatory_entry_filter: Volume delta and order-book imbalance must confirm directional momentum before the 0.01 lot order is dispatched.
profit_harvest_threshold: Aggressively harvest profits at +$5.00 to +$10.00 via trailing micro-stops to prevent peak evaporation.
